---
title: "Bruna Maria joins the lab as a Master's student"
description: "Macroecology of frog biodiversity facets responding to urbanisation in the Atlantic Forest."
date: "2025-02-15"
categories: [news, people]
---

Bruna Maria has joined the lab as a **Master's student**. She'll be testing
how multiple biodiversity facets of frogs respond to urbanisation in the
Brazilian Atlantic Forest, using a macroecological approach.
